Build a stratified bar table as a flextable

Source: R/bar_table.R
ft_bar_table.Rd

The Word/HTML counterpart of plot_bar_table(): a native table with a proportional mini-bar and the value in each outcome cell, stratifier headers in bold and nested rows indented.

ft_bar_table(
  data,
  measures,
  suppress_n = 25,
  caution_n = 50,
  notes = NULL,
  palette = vcs_palette(),
  font_size = 8.5,
  total_width = getOption("vaxsurvR.table_width", 6.7),
  label_width = 1.7
)

Arguments

data

A table from estimate_stratified() (needs stratum, row_type, indent).

measures

A list of bar_measure() specifications.

suppress_n

Suppress outcomes with n below this. NULL disables.

caution_n

Mentioned in the default note; outcomes below it should be read with caution.

notes

Footnote lines; NULL for the standard notes.

palette

A vcs_palette().

font_size

Body font size in points.

total_width

Table width in inches (the text width of the page).

label_width

Width of the row-label column in inches; the measure columns share the remainder.

Value

A flextable.

See also

plot_bar_table()
